findings.title: Optional.of(rs.getString(...)) throws NPE when email is SQL NULL
findings.recommendation: Use Optional.ofNullable(rs.getString("email")) so a NULL column yields Optional.empty() rather than an NPE; alternatively call rs.wasNull() to distinguish. Reachable path: row exists for the given id with email NULL -> getString returns null -> Optional.of(null) throws NPE (depends on the email column being nullable in the schema).
